licenseNormalization: Single terminal LF; legal text unchanged
scope: Preserve the first child, stdio stream, progress, output, cancellation-kill or setup failure and defer rejection until that exact child close; request kill at most once without masking the first failure.
limitations: Prepared source only; no installed package/application modification or admitted-runtime acceptance.
Tests execute the exact patched CommonJS source with a native Promise substitute for Bluebird; actual Bluebird/runtime integration remains a separate gate.
A child that never emits close remains pending; no exit-only fallback, timeout, kill-result inference or automatic retry is introduced.
Child close is not descendant-process termination, disk ownership, flush durability, payload integrity or installation permission.
Existing cancellation results and exit-code/error-array success semantics are preserved; no synthetic cancellation exception is introduced.
If close-observer registration itself fails, no close proof exists and the operation remains held; injected listener-registration failures are fixture boundaries, not a native runtime acceptance.

Cancellation classification remains unchanged: successful kill requests still resolve the legacy close code/error array; no typed cancellation reason or descendant-process termination proof is introduced.
